verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API for programmatically managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec. That covers much of the core UI surface, but nothing documents full UI parity. The OpenAPI probe's 404s at guessed paths do not contradict the documented download, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence of complete UI-to-API parity, API coverage of Boards, Query Assistant, BubbleUp and Canvas features, and independent hands-on corroboration of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.
To add markers via a command line tool, use either `curl` or [`honeymarker`](#honeymarker), a lightweight marker management tool that provides a CRUD command line interface.
